response.text:
I need to avoid creating an ap_gl_mismatch. The rejected attempt credited account 2000 (AP control) by 36.00 with no invoice backing, which made the AP subledger disagree with the GL for invoice 247. The alternative is to correct the expense side instead: reverse 36.00 of the 5500 debit, so the journal group nets to the amounts that match the AP side.

Proposed correction: a one-sided line that credits 5500 (Travel) by 36.00 in open period 12, referencing journal 1406. Combined with the original, 5500 nets to DR 1537.46 and 2000 stays at CR 1537.46, so the group balances and the AP control amount is unchanged. This keeps the AP side (account 2000) untouched and matches the invoice-backed credit of 1537.46.

Caveat: this assumes the 1537.46 credit is the correct amount and the 1573.46 debit is the mistyped side. That is the more likely reading, since the AP credit is the amount tied to the vendor invoice, but it should be confirmed against the source invoice for V0018-53532-247 before posting. No invoice status change, since this is not a duplicate_invoice finding.
